title: Extract persistence codecs for JSON-backed tables
description: Review finding from loreweaver-den. JSON parsing/stringifying and row-to-domain mapping are hand-rolled across memory, context assembly, and world query modules, increasing schema-change risk. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: Shared codecs or row mappers reduce duplicated JSON parse/stringify logic; malformed JSON failures are typed or consistently handled; existing persistence and world tests still pass.
close_reason: Completed in PRs #28 + #29 (merged) — jsonColumn codec adopted across all JSON-backed live-DB table columns

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Progress (PR for work/loreweaver-1a4): established persistence/jsonColumn.ts (typed jsonColumn<T> encode/decode codec) and migrated memory/turnTrace.ts off its ad-hoc stringifyTraceJson/parseTraceJson helpers. Remaining adoption for full close: memory/summary.ts (scene/session/arc summaries + campaign bible), world/forkCampaign.ts, persistence/checkpoint, and folding state/mutateState.ts serializeJsonValue into the shared codec. Issue stays open until those are migrated.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Progress (2nd PR, work/loreweaver-1a4): migrated memory/summary.ts (18 sites -> 9 per-column jsonColumn codecs). The memory subsystem (turn_trace + scene/session/arc summaries + campaign_bible) is now fully on the codec. Still remaining: module_*.data_json (forkCampaign write / worldQuery read), mutate_state value+JSON columns (serializeJsonValue uses MutateStateError), checkpoint snapshot serializer (blob-aware). Those need per-site decisions.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Completed on work/loreweaver-1a4 (PR #29): jsonColumn codec now adopted across every JSON-backed live-DB table column - turn_trace (PR #28), the four memory-summary tables, module_*, overlay_facts, plot_flags, character, inventory. mutateState keeps its MutateStateError contract by wrapping the codec. Checkpoint snapshot serializer deliberately excluded (blob-aware canonical Dolt snapshot, not a table-column codec). Issue closes when PR #29 merges.
